fact: LISGIS's December 2023 Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin, the first since 2011, was compiled from administrative data gathered from ministries, agencies and commissions with an Administrative Data Technical Committee, under the World Bank HISWA project.
title: Republic of Liberia Statistical Bulletin, Vol. 4 No. 01
publisher: Liberia Institute of Statistics and Geo-Information Services (LISGIS)
